tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: Run LoopFix's bounded deterministic audit for one public HTTP or HTTPS page and make it the active visible audit.

url.description: Complete public HTTP or HTTPS page URL to audit.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: List compact findings from the active LoopFix audit, optionally filtered by severity. Returns at most the requested limit and may truncate for output safety.

limit.description: Maximum findings to return; defaults to 10.

tools.name: inspect_finding
tools.description: Inspect one current finding's bounded evidence, rationale, and deterministic remediation guidance by finding ID.

tools.name: set_fix_scope
tools.description: Set the visible LoopFix fix scope to one through ten finding IDs from the active audit. This changes only local application state.

findingIds.description: One to ten current finding IDs to include in the fix scope.

tools.name: verify_fix_scope
tools.description: Re-audit the active canonical URL and compare the selected finding IDs. No replacement URL is accepted.
